🚀 SAPPHIRE 2026 Announcement

Joule Work Desktop Is Now Available to Every SAP Employee

SAP becomes Customer Zero for its own AI assistant — here's what it means for you.

July 29, 2026

As announced at SAPPHIRE by Sebastian Steinhaeuser, Joule Work Desktop is now generally available to every colleague at SAP. This isn't just a product launch — it's SAP practicing what we preach with #SAPrunsSAP.

What Just Happened

Joule Work Desktop — SAP's AI-powered digital assistant for the desktop — has gone GA (Generally Available) across the entire company. Every SAP employee now has access to AI assistance built into their daily workflow.

But here's what makes this significant: SAP isn't just releasing Joule to employees as a perk. We're running it the same way our customers will — through SAP Managed services.

🎯 Customer Zero — Twice

SAP is Customer Zero for both Joule Work Desktop and SAP Managed. Infrastructure, provisioning, updates, security, and operations are all handled by SAP — exactly as they will be for customers.

Why This Matters

When we talk to customers about AI adoption, we're now speaking from direct experience at enterprise scale. SAP has all the complexity that comes with being a company of our size — and we're testing Joule in that environment first.

What This Means for PMMs

  • Credibility boost: "We use it ourselves" is the strongest proof point you can have
  • Real feedback loop: Product issues get surfaced fast when 100K+ employees are using it daily
  • Story material: Every SAP employee's experience with Joule is a potential customer story
  • Competitive differentiation: Not every vendor eats their own AI cooking at this scale

The SAP Managed Angle

The fact that we're also Customer Zero for SAP Managed is just as important. This is the deployment model where SAP handles the operational complexity — infrastructure, provisioning, updates, security, operations.

For customers worried about AI implementation complexity, we can now say: "We run it the same way. We know exactly what you'll experience."

"That's how simple being an SAP customer can be."
— Philipp Düring, Head of Customer Office, SAP runs SAP

What To Do With This

If you're in a customer-facing role, start using Joule Work Desktop daily. Build your own experience. When you talk to customers about Joule, you'll have real stories — not just slides.

And when customers ask "does SAP actually use this?" — you can say yes, at full enterprise scale, managed the same way they would.

🙌 Try It Today

Joule Work Desktop is available now. Start using it and share your feedback.
